notes.note: Recorded that Windows archive service uninstall completes the same launcher-aware stop sequence as service stop before task removal. The focused Windows-dispatch fixture failed on the previous removal-first order and passed after restoration. Hosted Task Scheduler and actual archive delivery remain separate.

Reviewed the Windows archive uninstall entry, same-home registration lookup and launcher stop sequence. It ends the wrapper and waits for launcher shutdown before identity-checked lifecycle cleanup and task removal. Other service kinds keep their existing ordering, and the lifecycle refusal and home boundaries still apply. Focused CLI tests and a restored negative control checked the change; Windows runtime is pending hosted installer smoke.
